as_told.title: CIA approached Gary Nolan about the biological effects of UAP encounters

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the CIA, the US spy agency, came to Garry Nolan, a scientist at Stanford University, with files on people who had gone through strange, unexplained experiences. Michels puts this at around 2016 and says it was about the effects on the body of encounters with UAP, the official term for UFOs. If true, it would mean the spy agency was quietly asking top scientists to study harm from these encounters.
